analysis.reasonEn: Current price $149.30 approaches the lower Bollinger Band at $125.96. RSI at 37.5 is nearing oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving to -0.6757 but remains negative. Volume ratio at 0.73 is subdued. The price is not significantly above the 52-week low of $124.50 and shows no clear higher low formation compared to the 20-day low of $124.50. The trend remains downward, with the price below the 5-day high of $171.50 and 20-day high of $215.33. Price is below SMA5 ($148.25) and SMA20 ($172.48). Weekly RSI is 35.3 and weekly MACD histogram is -10.3478, indicating continued weakness. ADX at 47.9 shows strong trend, but -DI (41.3) is stronger than +DI (17.1). Overall, maintaining a wait-and-see approach until confirmation of buying momentum.
